bbox_protocol: Ultralytics AP IoU .50:.95, conf floor .001, NMS IoU .7, max_det 10; P/R at best F1 curve threshold, not fixed .25
center_protocol: original pixel Euclidean distance 10 and 50; max-cardinality/min-distance Hungarian matching; confidence .25, NMS IoU .7, max_det 10; positives only
unknown_policy: excluded, never treated as background; missing frames break consecutive miss runs

benchmark.e2e_scope: six complete validation videos; CPU decode + preprocessing + H2D + model + NMS + D2H + JSONL writes; initialization excluded; predictor rect=True
benchmark.peak_memory_scope: torch.cuda.max_memory_allocated during forward benchmark; includes resident YOLO and benchmark clone
benchmark.compute_scope: THOP supported modules incl Conv/Linear; functional operations such as attention matmul may be omitted; not an exact total; unfused model; FLOPs=2*MACs
benchmark.structure_note: Recomputed by reloading checkpoint before fusion; validation/predict had fused original instance in place.
